thread:
alex: Deploy cut is on hold — seeing repeated wheel extract EOF across multiple linux runners and a flaky integration test that only fails under matrix axis 'user-seed=7'.

maria: ugh. which job is the wheel extract failing in? show logs?

alex: failing in build:linux-wheel (x86_64, manylinux2014). snippet: 
```
+ tar -xzf dist/my_package-1.2.3-manylinux2014_x86_64.whl
error: unexpected EOF while reading
The command '/bin/sh -c python -m pip install dist/*.whl' returned a non-zero code: 2
```

kevin: same tar error on 3 different runners for the same artifact id. looks like partial upload or S3 multipart corruption.

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: change window today 1600-1800 UTC. Auto-fallback to last-good-image available (image: registry.redwood/ci-cache:2026-04-05-12).

maria: hm — do we have checksum recorded for that wheel? can we re-download from artifact store and verify etag?

alex: checksum in CI metadata: sha256=abcd1234... but the uploader job finished OK. Headers show Content-Length mismatch on some shards.

ci-runner: I retried the artifact download on one runner and it completed fine. But when pip tried to extract the wheel it hit EOF. Could be disk corruption on ephemeral runner or truncated upload to registry mirror.

kevin: There's also the integration flake. test_user_onboarding[user-seed=7] fails with a timeout hitting service X. It only shows up on slow CI nodes (post-extract slowdown). So both issues tie together: corrupted artifact -> slow/extract partial -> test times out.

alex: decision point: pin to last-good-image and unblock the cut, or re-run full matrix and hope artifacts reupload cleanly? Manual pin would violate the new changes in this cut but keeps release on schedule. Thoughts? @maria @kevin

maria: Given change window, I'm leaning pin to last-good-image and file follow-up. We need to investigate artifact upload path. If we rerun now, might waste CI slots and still block. :clock1:

kevin: I agree with pin. Also suggest we add a quick safety: add artifact checksum verify step in preflight so pip install fails faster and we don't waste time on extract.

alex: ok. proposal: pin registry image to registry.redwood/ci-cache:2026-04-05-12 for this promote, mark rollout as manual, and open an incident to investigate artifact multipart uploads and registry mirror replication.

sre-oncall: I'll take the incident. First checks: s3 multipart upload logs, registry storage node logs, and runner ephemeral disk health. Will correlate timestamps (around 1744444300 - 1744444400).

deploy-bot: Promotion action: require_manual_approval=true, applied pin image=registry.redwood/ci-cache:2026-04-05-12, hold_reason="artifact-extract-eof + flaky user-seed=7 test".

alex: I'll file the release notes blurb about manual pin and follow-ups. Keven/Kevin? (typo) kevin: will you open a PR for the preflight checksum step?

kevin: on it. PR link when ready. planning small script: curl -I artifact_url | grep -E 'Content-Length|ETag' then download and validate sha256 before pip install.

maria: thanks. I'll approve the manual promote once legal/pm sign off is confirmed (we have a doc change that landed in this cut).

sre-oncall: incident created INC-2026-042, assigned to infra-storage. early hypothesis: one of the registry replica nodes was in recovery window and returned truncated objects. Investigating.

alex: cool. summary: pin to last-good-image to unblock change window, file incident INC-2026-042 for artifact corruption, kevin to add checksum preflight PR, follow up post-cut to revert pin and rerun full matrix if needed.

maria: +1 

kevin: +1
